claims.text: LTX-2.5 is an open-weight model that generates synchronized video and audio from text, image and video inputs.
Commercial and production use is free under the LTX-2.x Community License for organisations under $10M annual revenue.
Native multishot generates connected scenes in one pass, keeping character, lighting and style across cuts.
The model page asks you to agree to share contact details before you can access it.

scenes.heading: VIDEO WITH *SOUND*
scenes.say: Most video models stop at silent clips. LTX-2.5 makes video and audio together, and you can run it yourself.

scenes.heading: ONE PASS, *SEVERAL SHOTS*
scenes.say: Its native multishot mode generates connected scenes in one pass, keeping the character, lighting and style steady across cuts.

scenes.label: annual revenue line for free commercial use
scenes.say: For organisations under ten million dollars in annual revenue, commercial use is free.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
cons: Model page asks you to share contact details first
pros: Free commercial use below the revenue line
scenes.say: The catch: the model page asks for contact details before access, and the revenue line decides whether commercial use is free. Open weights help you self-host.
Would you run this on your own machine? Tell me your setup in the comments.
